**Checklist for rule/collector ideas**

- [ ] The check is passive and read-only
- [ ] It can be expressed deterministically (no network beyond the check itself)
- [ ] You can describe what "healthy" looks like (for the verified/passed view)
- [ ] You can think of at least one false-positive case to test against
